name: Cluster Culling (Nanite-style)
definition: A hierarchical clustering and culling system for Gaussian splats, implementing Nanite-style spatial clustering for efficient LOD and frustum culling.
summary: Cluster Culling (Nanite-style) is a hierarchical frustum culling and LOD selection system for 3D Gaussian Splatting that efficiently culls invisible clusters, unlike sibling methods focused on merging.
